heading: 1.04.020 Title of Office.
full_text: Use of the title of any officer, employee, department, board, or commission shall mean that officer, employee, department, board, or commission of the City of Lincoln. (Ord. 15335 §2; November 6, 1989).

heading: 1.04.030 Interpretation of Language.
full_text: All words and phrases shall be construed according to the common and approved usage of the language, but technical words and phrases and such others as may have acquired a peculiar and appropriate meaning in the law shall be construed and understood according to such peculiar and appropriate meaning. (Ord. 15335 §3; November 6, 1989).
